headline: Executive order creates a federal Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and a separate stockpile of other digital assets held by the US government.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up two federal holdings: a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and a United States Digital Asset Stockpile for other digital assets, such as other cryptocurrencies. No summary was provided, so details are not available here, including where the assets come from, how they are managed, and whether any can be sold.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that hold or manage digital assets
who_it_affects.how: They would likely have to follow new rules for keeping and accounting for bitcoin and other digital assets the government holds.

who_it_affects.group: People and businesses that own or trade bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies
who_it_affects.how: The government would become a formal long-term holder of these assets, though the title does not say how this affects private owners.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 6, 2025; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
